CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents; A is absent.

COD.rationale: C, O and D are individually explicit but the explicit organizational claim spans both current and candidate items (mixed), producing ambiguity in a single compatible referent/time binding.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement tied to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified contents (color-labeled coordinate sets) at named referents/times.

D.rationale: The text separately attributes status/origin metadata to identified contents (distinct from the content coordinates).

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: The report states how contents are presented/organized (current vs candidate peaks and tabulated coordinate groupings).
